findings.title: An invalid address aborts send_batch
findings.trigger: parse_address raises InvalidAddress outside the try block.
findings.impact: Everyone after that recipient gets no digest and the ledger is never saved.

findings.title: isoweekday() is off by one from digest_weekday
findings.trigger: digest_weekday is 0 to 6 with Monday as 0; isoweekday() is 1 to 7.
findings.impact: Weekly digests arrive a day early and Monday digests never arrive.

findings.title: Subject line could name the period more clearly
findings.trigger: A weekly digest reads '12 updates this week'.
findings.impact: Cosmetic; consider including the date range.
